messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Two RStan Questions
parts:
What’s the command for creating a stanfit object from a CSV file
generated by CmdStan?

I believe I saw some reference of a function that would rerun
the diagnostics on an existing stanfit object — if I am not mistaken
then what is this function?

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Two RStan Questions
parts:
On Monday, January 30, 2017 at 11:39:27 PM UTC-5, Michael Betancourt wrote:
What’s the command for creating a stanfit object from a CSV file
generated by CmdStan?

I believe I saw some reference of a function that would rerun
the diagnostics on an existing stanfit object — if I am not mistaken
then what is this function?

Besides print()? I think you mean rstan:::throw_sampler_warnings(), which is not technically exposed. Most of the diagnostics are available through the bayesplot package through.

Ben
